name: Contiguity
title: contiguity.co
shortDescription: Contiguity offers a comprehensive suite of communication tools including SMS, email, and call services, aimed at developers and businesses of all sizes. It simplifies the integration of communication capabilities into applications with a promise of high deliverability and uptime. An example use case is a startup integrating SMS notifications for transaction confirmations.
